a higher transfer_likelihood must outweigh a concrete experimental mismatch.

L4 fraction-absorbed records show near-complete absorption for structurally analogous benzoyl carboxylic acids: ketoprofen Fa 90–100% in humans (C47, C50, C52, C53, C56), salicylic acid 100% (C46), and aspirin complete absorption (C54).

Repeated records are not independent.

The only low-F records are species-specific or vague (ampicillin 12% in veal calves, C26; nicotinic acid 'low bioavailability' note, C32) and do not provide transferable affirmative evidence for F<20% in this query.
